name: smwsprites-yi-bill-blaster-bullet-bill
title: YI Bill Blaster & Bullet Bill
description:
This is the Bill Blaster from Yoshi's Island, along with that smiling Bullet Bill. What's special about it is that before shooting it has a dynamic animation where it expands, and the Bullet Bill is larger than the Super Mario World's one.

Originally from smkdan's Yoshi's Island dynamic sprites pack.
